thread:
maria_ops: Heads up — APAC vendor (SunRail) just confirmed a lead-time slip for the batch of H100s we booked. ETA moved from 2026-04-12 to 2026-05-05 due to a customs backlog in SG port.
liam_procure: Ugh. How many units affected?
maria_ops: 48 units from PO# SR-8421 (all reserved for Dedicated pools). Vendor says 12 can be air-expressed sooner but at a premium.
kevin_logistics: Can we get a partial AWB for the 12? If we push those to SIN we can stage them into the enclave faster.
liam_procure: Price for air premium? Estimate ballpark so we can route approval.
sara_finance: need numbers. Air will hit O&M by a lot — pls provide delta per-GPU.
maria_ops: Vendor quoted +$4,200/unit for air (door-to-door, incl expedited customs brokerage). Sea remains original contract price.
na na_customs: customs backlog is mostly paperwork throughput; if we pre-clear docs and submit a temporary import bond we can shave ~3 business days. But bonds need underwriter signoff.
kevin_logistics: For the 12 air units we should ask vendor for consolidated AWB and a single invoice to simplify customs. rma-bot: Automated note: previous shipments with consolidated AWB reduced hold time by 28%.
liam_procure: Two options I see: 1) Pay premium to air-ship 12 to cover high-priority Dedicated queues now. 2) Keep sea for full 48 and accept delay, push work to cloud-burst. Also a hybrid: air 12 + expedite paperwork for the rest to reduce delay. Thoughts?
sara_finance: Hybrid wins for cost/latency balance but need authorization for the $50k premium. I'll approve if engineering stakes are higher than $100k risk.
maria_ops: Also RMA implications: vendor flagged 4 units as DOA in pre-check — they offered to replace under RMA but replacements will be part of the same delayed sea manifest unless we route them separately.
kevin_logistics: If we separate RMA replacements into an air shipment, cost multiplies. Could we use loaner pool from EU stash to cover immediate capacity? That requires cross-region transfer and swap logistics.
liam_procure: Is cross-region loaner feasible given our SLAs? Deployment leads said Dedicated clusters in APAC have 2-week window tolerance if we get 12 units earlier.
maria_ops: Deployment leads confirmed they can operate with 36 units short-term if 12 arrive. But 4 DOAs would still block certain tenant rollouts.
na na_customs: For the 36 sea units, I can push pre-clear if vendor provides serial manifest and HS codes in the next 24h. Please confirm we can get vendor manifest by EOD.
liam_procure: I'll request manifest and push for consolidated AWB for the 12. Maria, ask vendor for separate commercial invoice for the air leg and a separate RMA AWB for the 4 replacements.
sara_finance: If vendor insists on air for replacements, we should ask for cost share. They caused DOA so ask them to absorb at least 50% of RMA expedite.
maria_ops: pinged vendor (SunRail) — they replied: "Can do air for the 12 at +$4.2k/unit. RMA replacements: vendor willing to air 2/4 at no cost, rest on sea. Need confirmation re: consolidated AWB & temporary import bond."
kevin_logistics: Good. If vendor covers 2 DOAs air, that reduces our premium. Still need to finalize bond underwriter. Ana — any underwriter recs for short-bond?
na na_customs: I'll reach out to our broker (Pacific Surety) — typical turnaround 48h. If we OK hybrid today they can fast-track.
liam_procure: Proposal: Approve hybrid — air 12 + vendor covers air for 2 DOAs; issue temporary import bond for sea leg; get manifest by EOD; finance to approve up to $35k of premium.
sara_finance: Approved up to $35k now. If vendor covers the 2 RMA air replacements, net cost fits. If vendor doesn't, escalate.
maria_ops: I'll confirm with vendor and post manifest here. action items: liam to get manifest & commercial invoices; kevin to prepare AWB routing preference; ana to contact bond underwriter; sara to lock approval.
liam_procure: On it — sending vendor email now. cc @maria_ops @kevin_logistics.
rma-bot: RMA checklist reminder: include serials, failure codes, RMA authorization IDs, and photo evidence. Missing fields delay processing.
maria_ops: Noted. Also, we should create a temporary tag in inventory: "APAC-EXP-4202" for the 12 air units so on-receipt automation routes them to Dedicated pool.
kevin_logistics: I'll add the inbound tag to the AWB instructions.
maria_ops: Thanks team. Will update once manifest and vendor confirmation arrive.
liam_procure: Vendor just replied with manifest link: https://files.sunrail.com/manifests/SR-8421-4202.csv and AWB draft attached.
kevin_logistics: Got it. Looks clean. AWB shows origin: NRT, final: SIN-bonded.
maria_ops: Closing loop: hybrid approved. I'll post a brief escalation note to infra-all with ETA and expected temporary capacity delta.
sara_finance: Thx. Keep me posted if vendor reneges on the RMA cost share.
kevin_logistics: FYI — if customs rejects bond paperwork we fallback to air all RMA units; cost impact will be high.
maria_ops: Understood. Will monitor.
